faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Aftercare – Scalp Micropigmentation Ljubljana

list.q: How long does the healing take after SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation Ljubljana)?
list.a: Visible healing after SMP treatment – 2–5 days. Complete healing of scalp micropigmentation – 7–10 days. During this period, the pigment after SMP treatment Ljubljana stabilizes within the skin (hair tattoo).

list.q: Can I wash my head daily after the first week of SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation care)?
list.a: Yes, after SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation Ljubljana) you can wash your head after the first week, but only with mild products. Do not scrub after SMP treatment – just rinse and pat dry (hair tattoo care).

list.q: Can the pigment fade if I don’t follow proper aftercare (scalp micropigmentation care)?
list.a: Yes, pigment fading, spreading, or uneven tones may occur after SMP treatment. That’s why proper aftercare after SMP treatment Ljubljana is essential for long-lasting hair tattoo results.

list.q: What if my scalp itches after SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation Ljubljana)?
list.a: Do not scratch after SMP treatment! Gently pat with a dry tissue over the scalp micropigmentation area. Itching is a normal sign of healing after SMP treatment Ljubljana – part of the hair tattoo care process.
